title: Mexico's cartel wars
current_phase: The Sinaloa civil war is in its second year, and the CJNG is in succession after El Mencho's death.

history.text: The military-led crackdown splits the old cartels.
El Chapo is extradited and the CJNG rises.
El Mayo is abducted to the US and the Sinaloa war begins.

turning_points.text: El Mayo Zambada is flown to the US.

log.text: Authorities recaptured Los Ciclones' Axel Cárdenas in Matamoros, and Gulf Cartel cells answered with at least 15 blockades that left five or six dead and closed bridges to Texas.

log.text: Colombia detained Mexico City judge Luis Benítez Alcántara on a US request alleging a $2 million bribe tied to Ryan Wedding's network.
